title: Dodge Magnum Engines by Year (1978–2008)
description: Every factory engine in the Dodge Magnum by year: the 318, 360 and 400 V8s of the 1978–79 coupe, and the V6s, 5.7 Hemi and SRT8 6.1 of the 2005–08 wagon.
intro: Dodge used the Magnum name twice: for a personal-luxury coupe in 1978 and 1979, and for a rear-drive wagon from 2005 to 2008. There was no Magnum in between.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: 1978–1979 coupe
intro: The 318 and 360 small blocks and, for 1978 only, the 400 big block.

generations.name: 2005–2008 wagon (LX)
intro: The 2.7 and 3.5 V6s, the 5.7 Hemi in the R/T, and the 6.1 Hemi in the 2006–2008 SRT8.
